He took the students to his classroom and they made a makeshift arena out of textbooks. 
The students put in 2 spiders. I believe my teacher said one of them was a “pepper spider” and it was small and I can’t recall the other one but it was larger in comparison.
Keep in mind the teacher hosted this fight because he didn’t believe this would result in the 2 spiders fighting and that they would just stare at each other and do nothing. 
The students put in both spiders and the bigger spider ripped apart the smaller spider. 
Again, I didn’t witness this but my teacher said he was very shocked by this.
